changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS places ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, description TEXT,
latitude DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, longitude DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, geom GEOMETRY(Point, 4326),
nearest_road_name VARCHAR(255), nearest_road_highway VARCHAR(100), nearest_road_distance DOUBLE PRECISION,
rating DOUBLE PRECISION CHECK (rating >= 1 AND rating <= 5), rating_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
category VARCHAR(100),
created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW() );
